==Usage==
For articles considered [[Canon|non-canon]] in the current canon continuity, include the parameter "canon" with any value. Example: <code><nowiki>{{Noncanon|canon=1}}</nowiki></code>

For articles considered [[Canon|non-canon]] that are from ''[[Star Wars: Visions]]'', include the parameter "visions" with any value. Example: <code><nowiki>{{Noncanon|visions=1}}</nowiki></code>

For articles considered [[Canon|non-canon]] that are from [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO]] material, include the parameter "lego" with any value. Example: <code><nowiki>{{Noncanon|lego=1}}</nowiki></code>

For articles considered [[Canon|non-canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, include the parameter "legends" with any value. Example: <code><nowiki>{{Noncanon|legends=1}}</nowiki></code>

For real-world articles considered non-canon, include the parameter "real" with any value so that the category will not be applied. Example: <code><nowiki>{{Noncanon|real=1}}</nowiki></code>
